prompt: The sharp spines of a cactus are not just weapons. What are they, in botanical terms?

options.text: Thickened roots that grew above ground
Dried flower stalks left after blooming
Modified leaves that lose very little water

explanation: Cactus spines are modified leaves. Their tiny surface area cuts water loss, while photosynthesis happens in the thick green stem instead.
